subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should this PR be repaired and treated as the canonical fix for the Telegram long-model picker bug, or should maintainers switch to another open candidate?
rationale: There are multiple open candidate PRs for the same linked issue, and this PR now has one narrow correctness blocker plus a failing Telegram smoke check that maintainers should resolve before choosing the landing path.

options.title: Repair and keep this PR canonical
options.body: Fix the sort-order mismatch, rerun the focused Telegram proof/checks, and use this token-guarded implementation as the landing candidate.

options.title: Switch to another candidate
options.body: Compare the open alternative fix PR and close or supersede this PR only if the other branch has the same stale-index safety and cleaner validation.

options.title: Pause pending CI diagnosis
options.body: Hold all candidate PRs until the failing Telegram smoke check is understood if maintainers suspect a broader channel regression.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep this PR canonical
recommendation.body: Fix the sort-order mismatch, rerun the focused Telegram proof/checks, and use this token-guarded implementation as the landing candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current-history owner for the Telegram callback/model-button surface and recent release carry-forward.
